title: fix(lint): os validate and os build resolve a report's dataset through the reading package's declared closure, as the runtime does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Fixes #33128

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：多包产物逐包检查时，报表（含 joined 块、列表视图图表、页面图表）引用的 dataset 改为和看板一样按「本包 → 已声明依赖闭包里唯一持有者」解析；依赖包的数据集不再被 `os validate` / `os build` 误报 `chart-dataset-unknown`。
- 为什么改：运行时本来就按 `callerPackage` 从依赖闭包解析报表的数据集并正常返回，作者期却只看本包自己的 `datasets`，有效的模块化应用构建不过（看板那一半已由 #33121 修好，这是报表那一半）。
- 风险与回滚：只放行运行时本来就放行的引用；闭包外的持有者、闭包内两个持有者仍然报错（现在会点名持有者并给出可行改法），发布门不变，运行时不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts` 的 `resolveDataset`（拒绝与警告两支）和 `indexDatasets`（改读看板同一份解析结果）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts`，预期 91/91 通过，其中 `[#33128]` 一组 11 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** The binding resolves through `indexArtifactDatasetResolution`, the resolution `widget-dataset-unknown` and `report-filter-field-unknown` already read; this PR adds no second walk and no wider reach. A dataset only an undeclared package holds stays refused: `REFUSES a report over a dataset only an UNDECLARED package holds, naming the holder and the dependency to declare`, and the CONTROL half of `ACCEPTS the same dependency’s dataset on a joined block, a list-view chart and a page chart`. The phase-1 one-holder tests are not touched (`packages/core`, `packages/objectql` are outside the diff); bare-name URL behaviour is not touched (no runtime file in the diff).
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** `REFUSES a name two packages of the closure hold, naming both: nothing picks one (red line 2)` asserts the code, the severity, the path and the message's first clause naming both holders, and that the report's positions are judged against neither. `REPORTS, not refuses, when the reader declares a dependency the artifact does not carry; never softens an ambiguity` keeps it an error when an outside dependency is declared. Ablation A4 (the resolver picks the first holder) turns both red.
3. **Independently releasable.** One package (`@objectstack/lint`, `patch`), no runtime answer moves, nothing in this diff waits on a sibling card. No migration: nothing stored changes. No behaviour moves between layers, so no ADR-0087 entry is owed (the authoring gate stops refusing what the runtime serves).

## What changes

| Door | FROM (main 47f6c939) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, per-package pass: a report, joined block, list-view chart or page chart bound to a dataset a package it declares holds (transitively) | `chart-dataset-unknown` error, "resolves to no declared dataset … Declared datasets: (none)" | accepted; its rows, values and chart axes are judged against that dataset |
| same, a dataset only a package outside the declared closure holds | the same generic error | `chart-dataset-unknown` error naming the holder and the open fix (declare the dependency, or move when the holder already depends on the reader): the dashboard rule's sentence |
| same, a dataset two packages inside the closure hold | the same generic error | `chart-dataset-unknown` error naming both; nothing picks one |
| same, outside the closure, and the reader declares a dependency the artifact does not carry | the same generic error | `chart-dataset-unknown` **warning**: not judged, that package may hold it once installed (the dashboard rule's S1 arm) |
| the union run with a residual top-level `datasets` beside the composition (`manifest: 'preserve'`) | a module's report on the module's own dataset refused | accepted: the union run reads every body, as the dashboard rule does |
| a dataset no package declares; a stack without `packages[]`; the publish door (its write snapshot carries no `packages[]`) | error / unchanged | unchanged |

Why every surface of this rule and not only reports: every reader it judges sends its own served package as `callerPackage` (`DatasetReportRenderer`, `ObjectChart`, the list view's chart in `objectViewListRenderer.tsx`), and the dataset doors resolve the name from that package by ADR-0150 D3: "`?callerPackage=P` names the package of the item that reads the name (a dashboard, report or chart of P) … The name resolves from P by D3" (ADR-0150, amendment note of 2026-11-11). On the per-package pass every item is the judged package's, so one resolution serves all three surfaces.

Which resolver: the order points at `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`. PR #33121's dashboard half resolves with `indexArtifactDatasetResolution` (`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts`), over `packageResolutionClosure` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`); core's module holds the D3 rule's runtime vocabulary, which the lint does not call. This PR imports that same lint function and its two wording functions; nothing is copied, and neither `package-scoped-resolution.ts` nor `validate-widget-bindings.ts` is edited.

`validate-report-runtime-filter.ts` (review nit N1 on PR #33121), re-judged: it does not share the defect. It has read `indexResolvableDatasets`, the same closure-aware index, since #33121, so a report's `runtimeFilter` over a declared dependency's dataset already resolves that dataset. No change. Its per-package pass leaves a refused name unjudged, and `chart-dataset-unknown` now carries that verdict with the reason; the union run still judges the filter.

Clause-② reads `no`: the lint now accepts only what the runtime and ADR-0150 D3 already accept (the quotation above); no published contract refuses it. Metadata-protocol reads `none`: no key, value or type is added or removed, no meaning or default changes (the authoring gate stops a false refusal); copied from the claim.

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts`, one new top-level `describe`, `[#33128] chart-dataset-unknown resolves through the reading package’s declared closure` (11 cases):

- ACCEPTS a report over the dataset of a package it declares, and judges its positions against it
- resolves a TRANSITIVE dependency’s dataset (the declared closure, ADR-0141)
- ACCEPTS the same dependency’s dataset on a joined block, a list-view chart and a page chart (CONTROL: each refused without the dependency)
- REFUSES a report over a dataset only an UNDECLARED package holds, naming the holder and the dependency to declare (code, severity, where, path, full message)
- names the move, never the dependency, when the holder already depends on the reader (a cycle)
- REFUSES a name two packages of the closure hold, naming both: nothing picks one (red line 2)
- the reading package’s own dataset wins a name its dependency also holds (ADR-0150 D3 step 1)
- REPORTS, not refuses, when the reader declares a dependency the artifact does not carry; never softens an ambiguity
- a name NO package declares, and any stack judged without the artifact, keep the unchanged sentence
- the union run reads every body, as the dashboard rule does: a residual top-level `datasets` no longer hides the module’s own (CONTROL: the app's per-package pass is refused with the cycle hint)
- reaches the rule table the per-package pass runs; the publish door’s snapshot is unchanged

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured first** at `origin/main` 47f6c939, `validateChartBindings` on the per-package shape (module `com.example.m` declares `com.example.d`, which holds `ds`; the module's report reads `ds`): one `chart-dataset-unknown` error, "binds dataset "ds", which resolves to no declared dataset — there is no data to render." / "Declared datasets: (none)."
- **Grep of the surface** for `ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`: `validate-chart-bindings.ts:93` names the maintainer ruling on `chart-field-unknown` (presentation positions warn, query positions error); this diff moves no position's severity. `validate-report-runtime-filter.ts`: no hit. `package-scoped-resolution.ts`: not edited; no export was needed.
- **`validate-report-date-range.ts`** (not in this surface) indexes `stack.datasets` alone, so on the per-package pass a report's `dateRange` over a declared dependency's dataset is not judged there; the union run judges it. Not a false refusal and no verdict lost; noted, not filed.
- **Filter keys on a dependency's dataset** (both `report-filter-field-unknown` and the dashboard twin): the per-package object graph holds the package's own objects, so a key on an object the dependency holds is skipped on that pass and judged on the union run. Probe at this head: a report over the dependency's dataset with `runtimeFilter: { nope: 'x' }` gives no per-package finding. The twin behaves the same; noted, not filed.
- A top-level residual report beside a composition is judged on the union run against every body, as the dashboard rule judges a residual dashboard since #25514; unchanged in kind, now the same for both rules.

## Verification

All at head `60edc5ee`, worktree off `origin/main` 47f6c939 (`git merge origin/main`: already up to date).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 59 families, each run with stdin from `/dev/null`, exit codes captured before any pipe; `--ran`: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 59 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Three first runs were prerequisite failures, not reds, and are recorded at their rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 on the shallow clone (its pinned fixture commit unreachable), exit 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`; `check:dts-closure` exit 1 and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/`) after an `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` CLI build of mine, both exit 0 after a full `pnpm build` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Dogfood battery: n/a, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
